content: {"episode_id":"ep-05110","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring) for episode ep-05110. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with recurrent episodes of unexplained syncope and near-syncope (R55), raising concern for intermittent arrhythmia. Given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73), prolonged mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptoms with potential cardiac rhythm disturbances. The payer letter states advance approval is required to ensure medical necessity; the authorization was missing, and we request retrospective authorization and reprocessing based on this documented indication."}
